field_changes.before: Each command must settle within 5 s; shared PID log must include every expected started root and all recorded fixture processes must be dead afterward.
field_changes.after: Each command must settle within 5 s; the shared log must satisfy pids.len() >= started, an aggregate lower bound on complete PID entries. That count does not identify every expected root individually; assert_dead_logged subsequently checks the PIDs actually recorded.

field_changes.before: Sends a 64 KiB OMNI_BIG value, exceeding the socket-buffer scale while staying below Linux single-env-string limits.
field_changes.after: Sets OMNI_BIG to 64 KiB of x; the source comment compares that size with an 8 KiB socket buffer and Linux's 128 KiB limit for one environment string. This test does not measure/configure socket capacity or establish that EMSGSIZE or its fallback branch occurred.

field_changes.before: Requires successful fixture execution and exact printed value framing/length under a 30 s timeout.
field_changes.after: Configures a 30 s command timeout and requires successful exit, text.starts_with("OMNI_BIG=\"xxx"), and text.trim_end().len() == big.len() + 11; the assertions do not compare the complete returned value or validate full framing.

limits: Documentary identity, exact field-diff and source-quote checks only; no semantic decision or runtime result is inferred.
